name: ensemblai
description: Real adoption data for PyPI and npm packages: downloads, growth, competitive comparison and ownership — so Claude measures instead of guessing from training data. Free trial built in; add a Pro key for full limits.

api_key.title: EnsemblAI API key (optional)
